status_note: The eleven-line covered projection matches Rule2Comp2Sub::getOpList and all five applyOp shapes (two orientations of the lone-INT_ADD transform plus three rejects) against locked Ghidra 12.0.4 byte for byte. Pool-repeat convergence and pipeline scheduling are outside this projection (the rule runs one-shot per case).

architecture.spaces: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5, join=6, iop=7; byte addressed
architecture.type_factory: one architecture-owned factory shared by all cases; canonical xunknown1/2/4/8 (no case reads a datatype)

compiler_spec.calling_convention: empty input/output records; no effects, symbols, or injections

analysis_options.api: Direct production Rule2Comp2Sub::getOpList once and Rule2Comp2Sub::applyOp once per case; no ActionGroup, pool repeat, or other Rule runs
analysis_options.funcdata: Fresh synthetic Funcdata and BlockBasic per case; high-level mode disabled
analysis_options.ir: V=register:0x40 and W=register:0x50 four-byte inputs; a CPUI_INT_2COMP(W) at ram:0x2000 with a four-byte unique output; case-specific consumers at ram:0x2010/0x2020 with unique outputs; all edges installed through Funcdata APIs
analysis_options.normalization: None. The emitted projection uses semantic scalar values and exact within-case identity booleans; opcode numbers, list counts, dead flags, and def-use counts are not normalized. The 2COMP output is not touched after a firing applyOp (Funcdata::opDestroy frees it); its descendant count prints '-' there by contract on both sides.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; construction and rule execution are deterministic

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(cases, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

cases.ir: V,W register inputs; 2COMP(W) at ram:0x2000 with unique out; ADD(V,2COMP-out) at ram:0x2010 with unique out; both ops inserted in one block
cases.expect: return 1; the ADD becomes INT_SUB with V in slot 0 and W in slot 1; the 2COMP op is destroyed (dead, inputs unset, out varnode freed)

cases.ir: same skeleton; ADD(2COMP-out,V) with the negation in slot 0
cases.expect: return 1; the slot-0 swap moves V to slot 0; the ADD becomes INT_SUB(V,W); the 2COMP is destroyed

cases.ir: same skeleton; INT_MULT(2COMP-out, 2) as the lone consumer
cases.expect: return 0; lone consumer is not an INT_ADD; nothing changes

cases.ir: same skeleton; the 2COMP output has no consumers
cases.expect: return 0; loneDescend is null; nothing changes

cases.ir: same skeleton; two INT_ADDs both read the 2COMP output
cases.expect: return 0; more than one descendant; nothing changes

observation_schema.format: Eleven fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one getOpList record followed by before/after records for the five cases
observation_schema.rule_result_and_opcode: Exact getOpList count/opcode, applyOp return, both ops' opcode and dead state
observation_schema.identity: Slot-0/slot-1 identity booleans of each consumer against V, W, and the 2COMP output
observation_schema.def_use_and_lifecycle: V/W/2COMP-output descendant counts, alive/dead op counts, and block op counts

decisive_semantics.references_and_outputs: MATCH for all five cases: the destroyed 2COMP (dead op, freed output) and the rewritten consumer op; opDestroy's freed-output contract is projected as '-' rather than dereferenced.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_and_order: MATCH for getOpList's single push and the straight-line applyOp guards; loneDescend's zero-or-many reject is covered by no_descend/two_descend.
decisive_semantics.counters_and_accumulators: MATCH for alive/dead/block counts: each fired case moves exactly one op from alive to dead.
decisive_semantics.sort_and_comparison_keys: MATCH for the covered pointer-identity comparisons (consumer slot identity against V/W/2COMP-out) and the CPUI_INT_ADD opcode gate.

coverage.pool_repeat_convergence: UNTESTED: direct one-shot Rule invocation only
coverage.malformed_ir_and_exceptions: OUT_OF_DOMAIN: locked applyOp assumes a binary INT_2COMP dispatched by the Rule pool
